dataset_name: Curated Research Dataset of Authoritative Clinical Guidelines for Medical Decision Support
dataset_type: Medical Knowledge Base for RAG Decision Support
description: A curated research dataset containing 30 authoritative clinical practice guidelines and evidence-based consensus statements. Sourced strictly from recognized medical societies and public health bodies to provide grounded medical travel and clinical decision support across the 8 specialties represented in Phase 2 synthetic clinical reports.
authoritative_organizations: Society of American Gastrointestinal and Endoscopic Surgeons (SAGES)
Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD)
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
traceability_guarantee: All documents are derived from published clinical guidelines, peer-reviewed medical journals, or official medical society guidelines with traceable citations and official URLs. Zero synthetic or fabricated medical citations.

schema.title: Clinical guideline title
schema.specialty: Medical specialty domain corresponding to Phase 2
schema.condition_covered: Primary clinical condition or procedure addressed
schema.source_reference: Standard academic/clinical citation (authors, journal/guideline name, year)
schema.reference_url: Traceable official guideline URL or DOI
schema.clinical_evidence_level: Guideline evidence grade (e.g., Level A, Level B, Consensus Recommendation)
schema.content: Full clinical guideline excerpt with actionable criteria, contraindications, and travel safety guidance
schema.keywords: Clinical keywords for indexing and verification
